{{Quote|Imperial escort frigate ''Far Orbit'': this is Esseles Space Control, You are entering controlled space. Transmit your orders and code clearance.|Esseles Space Control|<ref name="CCV">{{WEGCite|book=The Far Orbit Project|story=The Capture of Coh Veshiv}}</ref>}}
'''Esseles Space Control''' was an organization responsible for overseeing and regulating space traffic within the [[Essesia system]]. Incoming [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessels, were queried by Esseles Space Control and challenged to provide authorization credentials to travel through the [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="CCV" />
